SOURCE_PRECHECK: The branch is fetch transport only. The exact commit above is authoritative; fetch it, verify the commit object and exact HEAD, and do not use the stale main checkout or a moving tip as the implementation source.
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/work/codex-f89-network-page-localization-r1
DELIVERY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/deliveries/codex-f89-network-page-localization-r1
SCOPE: Audit and edit the model network route and its focused tests, plus only the existing core locale catalog files or feature-owned catalog tests required for six-locale coverage: packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/network/page.tsx, packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/network/page.test.tsx, packages/core/src/locale.ts, packages/core/src/locale-catalogs.ts, and narrowly related network catalog files under packages/core/src.
MISSION: Close the verified F-89 route gap. The current model Network page contains hardcoded operator-facing English and renders a backend lastError directly, while its network child controls already use the shared locale provider. Localize the mounted route without changing network, OAuth, role, model-scope, social-account, disconnect, or child-control behavior.
PASS_CRITERIA: 1. Resolve SOURCE_REF exactly, create COPY_ROOT from that commit, and prove the source HEAD before editing. 2. Make real source changes only inside COPY_ROOT; a copied baseline, docs-only claim, generated output, or helper-only change is not a delivery. 3. The route must resolve the persisted server locale and use the existing typed catalog for fixed copy, owner access denial, network load failure, OAuth success notice, egress mode and health labels, social connection guidance, role-gated connection controls, account load failure, empty state, table headings, and action labels across en, es, ja, it, pt-BR and de. User/provider/account identifiers, capability values and provider data remain data; do not translate them implicitly. Do not render network.lastError or any raw backend exception text. 4. Preserve the existing owner-only network fetch, operational-role OAuth links, modelId query binding, NetworkForm, EgressCredentials, NetworkHealth, ActivateNetwork and DisconnectSocialAccountButton callsites and API payloads. Do not weaken role gates or claim provider/runtime success. 5. Add focused behavior tests for owner and non-owner access, network load failure, connected/invalid OAuth query handling, account load failure versus empty accounts, localized representative output for all six locales, and absence of raw backend error text. Add or update catalog completeness tests for every new key. 6. Run the focused dashboard tests, owning core catalog tests, dashboard typecheck and dashboard lint; record exact commands and real exit codes. 7. DELIVERY must list the exact source HEAD, COPY_ROOT and DELIVERY_ROOT, changed paths, independently reproducible SHA-256 per changed file, behavior-test names and counts, typecheck/lint results, and a changed-file summary. Include LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE and state that no deployment, installer, migration, database, provider, OAuth, credential, permission, systemd, network or runtime action occurred.
CORRECTION_BOUNDARY: If an existing shared catalog key is sufficient, reuse it. If a new key is required, add only feature-owned keys to all six catalogs with a focused completeness test. If the current contracts cannot satisfy a criterion without an unapproved schema, provider or runtime change, return one terminal BLOCKED naming the exact conflict instead of inventing a feature.
BOUNDARY: LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations or migration execution, providers, OAuth calls, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, generated output outside COPY_ROOT, or files outside the named scope. Do not use dates, clocks or filesystem timestamps for coordination.
HANDOFF: Codex audits and integrates only a hash-verified DELIVERY, runs owning checks, commits and pushes the reviewed milestone. ACK/REPLIED is transport only and is not implementation delivery.
sincerely, Codex
